{{Quote|The old interstellar relays are down. You can't just pick the person you're going to call out here.|[[Kerra Holt]]|<ref name="Aflame 4" />}}
A '''communications relay''', also known as an '''interstellar routing station''', '''interstellar relay''', or '''hyperspace relay''', was a [[Space station/Legends|structure]] in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that served as conduits for transmissions. Commonly referred to as a '''relay''', it made up a communications network that spanned much of the known [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], connecting its citizens.

Relay stations were also employed for handling messages of classified information by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which, at its peak, was the dominant [[Politics/Legends|government]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

Under [[Dictatorship/Legends|Imperial]] rule, relay stations responsible for secure channels were manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] and fitted with mounted [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]]. Put in deep-space, they were placed near [[communications satellite]]s.

==Description==
Communications relays served as interstellar routing stations which bound [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by allowing transmissions being made throughout a communications network. When shut down, no secure transmissions could be made unless one reactivates one such station.<ref name="Aflame 4" />

[[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] manufactured<ref name="XWA" /> interstellar relays<ref name="Knight Errant">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref> with mounted [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]], and the [[Space station/Legends|space machinery]] was utilized by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. These [[Dictatorship/Legends|Imperial]] relays were located near [[communications satellite]]s in [[Realspace/Legends|deep-space]].<ref name="XWA" />

==History==
By around<ref name="Aflame 1" /> [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]],<ref name="1032 BBY">''Knight Errant: Aflame'' 1 establishes itself as taking place [[Millennium/Legends|one thousand years]] before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. As the publication's timeline states that the events of ''The Phantom Menace'' occured in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], ''Knight Errant: Aflame'' 1 must take place circa [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].</ref> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] disabled much of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] communications network by deactivating their communication relays amidst the [[New Sith|Sith]] [[New Sith Wars|invasion]] of [[Politics/Legends|Republic territories]].<ref name="Aflame 1" /> This greatly affected the galactic citizenry, as populations under the threat of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] lost contact with other worlds, becoming unable to contact [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] for help. With the Sith rampaging unchecked,<ref name="Aflame 4" /> this [[Time/Legends|time period]] became known as the [[Republic Dark Age|Dark Age of the Republic]].<ref name="Aflame 1" />

Prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Imperial [[Treason/Legends|defector]] [[Zaletta]] used a relay [[Comm Center]] to divert messages and inform the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] of Imperial activity. A skirmish was initiated in order to trace Zaletta.<ref name="XWA" />
